system.description: You experience intense vertigo and nausea when interfacing with any type of virtual reality or XP. Apply a –30 modifier to your actions when using VR or XP. If using VR/XP for a prolonged period (an hour+), you must make a SOM Check or be incapacitated for 10 minutes. Even augmented reality makes you dizzy; suffer a –10 modifier while interfacing with AR.
